question: Should ClickClack replace its current paper-and-ember web identity with the Switchboard keycap design across the application?
rationale: This is a broad, permanent branding and product-taste choice across nearly every primary web surface, which source review cannot resolve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt Switchboard
options.body: Accept the cohesive redesign after the branch is rebased and its final light and dark renders are verified.

options.title: Adopt selected elements
options.body: Keep selected tactile states, typography, or token cleanup while retaining the current palette and identity.

options.title: Keep paper and ember
options.body: Decline the product-wide rebrand and retain the current visual direction.

recommendation.title: Adopt Switchboard
recommendation.body: Accept the cohesive redesign after the branch is rebased and its final light and dark renders are verified.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current design language and has the strongest recent history across the affected styling and sidebar surfaces.
